title: mimi-mls: mark group out of sync on hub-accepted commit we reject
description: From .4.3: if the hub accepts a commit that this Member then rejects (e.g. AppDataRejected), group state is kept but nothing marks the group out of sync (AGENTS.md: never delete group state on failure; mark out of sync and wait). Add the out-of-sync state and surface it to the agent.
